auth_type.description: Authentication mechanism. Either one of `OAUTH2`, or `SERVICE_PRINCIPAL`. Default value `OAUTH2`

domain_name.description: The custom domain name associated with Dynamics 365.

resource_url.description: URL at which Dynamics 365 is accessed

client_id.description: Client ID of your Dynamics 365 client application, or service principal.

client_secret.description: Client Secret of your Dynamics 365 client application, or service principal.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
